scope: Two specific numerical requirements from §3.2.2, NOT the full section, complete decision-tree interpretation/construction, all source requirements or confirmed mastery.

obligations.capability: Calculate the weighted-average financial outcome across chance outcomes in a decision tree, including negative branches.
obligations.assessed_response: one final numerical value; workings and tree construction unscored

obligations.capability: Deduct a certain option cost from the probability-weighted expected value in a decision-tree scenario.
obligations.assessed_response: one final numerical value; workings and business judgement unscored

excluded_and_unverified: mission, objectives, ethics, environment, competition and resource constraints
real signed-in learner progress/recheck and adaptive plan
